statusDefinitions.implemented: Implemented in the product or delivery process with repository evidence.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some controls exist, but enterprise evidence or a material capability is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.planned: Required before broad enterprise claims; not currently represented as complete.
statusDefinitions.customer_dependent: Availability or assurance depends on the selected customer deployment.

controls.control: Named security and privacy ownership, annual policy approval, and risk review
controls.gap: Assign accountable officers and retain dated approvals and risk-review minutes.

controls.control: SOC 2 Type II or equivalent independent control report
controls.gap: Complete readiness assessment, observation period, and independent audit; never imply certification before issuance.

controls.control: Independent penetration test and tracked remediation
controls.gap: Commission an authenticated web/API test and provide an executive letter under NDA.

controls.control: Production authentication and server-derived tenant ownership
Enterprise SSO, enforced MFA, SCIM, RBAC, and access reviews
controls.gap: Add SAML/OIDC SSO, organization roles, lifecycle provisioning, MFA policy enforcement, and quarterly access-review evidence.

controls.control: Private storage, TLS, cache prevention, owner isolation, and complete record deletion
Customer-specific retention schedules and verified deletion reporting
controls.gap: Add configurable automatic expiry, legal holds, deletion receipts, and backup-expiry confirmation.

controls.control: Tenant-managed encryption keys and selectable data residency
controls.gap: Offer customer-managed keys or a customer-hosted data plane and document supported regions.

controls.control: Secure headers, bounded inputs, upload verification, capability-link protection, and generic errors
Malware scanning and content disarm for uploaded files
controls.gap: Quarantine uploads until malware scanning succeeds; evaluate PDF content disarm and reconstruction.

controls.control: CI tests, static analysis, dependency updates, reviewable changes, and secret separation
Dependency vulnerability SLA, SBOM, artifact provenance, and release approvals
controls.gap: Generate an SBOM for releases, sign artifacts, protect the production environment, and retain remediation metrics.

controls.control: Dossier activity audit trail and privacy-safe server errors
Central security monitoring, authentication telemetry, alerting, and immutable retention
controls.gap: Connect identity, hosting, storage, and application events to monitored alerting with documented retention and escalation.

controls.control: Documented severity, containment, evidence, notification, recovery, and lessons-learned process
controls.gap: Assign named responders, counsel and forensic contacts; approve and exercise the plan at least annually.

controls.control: Documented continuity, backup, recovery, RTO/RPO, and restoration exercises
controls.gap: Contractually set service targets, confirm vendor backup behavior, and record successful restore and failover exercises.

controls.control: Subprocessor inventory, purpose, data access, location, and change process
controls.gap: Verify vendor legal entities, regions, DPAs, assurance reports, breach terms, and customer notice mechanism before contracting.

controls.control: DPA coverage for roles, instructions, confidentiality, security, subprocessors, rights, deletion, audits, and transfers
controls.gap: Have qualified counsel adapt and approve customer-facing DPA, privacy notice, terms, and transfer mechanism.

controls.control: Documented data inventory, purpose limitation, minimization, and data-subject request procedure
controls.gap: Complete jurisdiction-specific record of processing and operationalize identity verification and response deadlines.

controls.control: No-training posture, provider approval gate, customer-owned gateway, sanitization, provenance, and human review
Model/vendor evaluation, documented limitations, change control, red-team testing, and AI incident monitoring
controls.gap: Establish release-specific model evaluations and retain approval, regression, and incident evidence.

controls.control: Public vulnerability intake and safe-harbor policy
controls.gap: Verify that security@greenlit.ai is a monitored inbound mailbox, assign triage coverage, and test acknowledgement/escalation.

controls.control: Background screening, confidentiality, security training, onboarding, and immediate offboarding
controls.gap: Adopt jurisdiction-appropriate personnel controls and retain completion and revocation evidence.

controls.control: Cyber, technology E&O, and appropriate commercial insurance
controls.gap: Purchase coverage matched to contractual limits and provide a certificate under NDA.
